title.narrative: Empowering CSOs to Promote Inclusive and Green Post-COVID Recovery in Multi-ethnic Kvemo Kartli Region

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to building robust and climate-resilient rural communities via strengthening local institutions to better perform their roles as actors of local governance for improvement of access to social services for poor and vulnerable groups (VGs) in rural areas of Georgia. The specific objective is to increase the capacity of local CSOs to act as community integration and development actors for promotion of inclusive and green post-COVID recovery and provision of person-centred social services, with a particular focus on water and health, for people in vulnerable situations in the multi-ethnic region of Kvemo Kartli.
